name: Plant-Based Snacking
instructions: Pair a plant protein or fat with a carb in every snack (hummus + veggies, apple + almond butter) to stay satisfied.
Keep a few plant-based go-tos pre-portioned and visible, the same way you would with any snack strategy.
Roasted chickpeas or edamame make a higher-protein alternative to chips when you want something crunchy.
Watch today's video for snack ideas, then swap in a plant-based protein pairing.
